input.rationale: Section 9 ("Warranties") contains only mutual corporate existence/authority/enforceability warranties (p0056-p0057) and a Globix acknowledgement (p0058). There is no affirmative HDI warranty anywhere in the Agreement that the Site, the software/administration tools or the development and hosting services will conform to documentation or perform properly, and no warranty remedy: searches for "AS IS", implied-warranty disclaimers, workmanlike/professional standards, conformance to documentation, malicious code and error correction all return nothing, and Sections 1 and 5 contain only scope, operational-date and acceptance mechanics. That fails the fallback on every material term, so we insert the shortest fallback warranty in Section 9: 90-day documentation conformance for the Site and any HDI software, 30-day services conformance, with repair/replacement or refund at the Company's election. We have targeted fallback rather than preferred (12-month software period, workmanlike standard, legal compliance, no-malicious-code) to keep the change minimal.

ops.text: HDI warrants that (1) for ninety (90) days following the Company's acceptance, the Site and any software HDI delivers or makes available to the Company hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (2) for thirty (30) days following performance, the services performed by HDI under this Agreement will conform to the requirements of this Agreement. For breach of this warranty, HDI shall, at the Company's election, repair or replace the non-conforming Site, software or services, or refund the amounts paid by the Company for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 carries only corporate-authority warranties, so HDI stands behind none of its development or hosting work. We have inserted our fallback performance warranty: 90 days documentation conformance for the Site and software, 30 days for the services, with repair/replacement or refund as the remedy.
proposal.summary: Insert HDI performance warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day services) with repair/replace or refund remedy.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
